mean.exact_model: Sum independently transcribed decimal source coefficients times exact powers of supplied binary64 epoch. Sun is exact Earth polynomial plus180 before final cyclic reduction.
mean.rounding: nearest IEEE binary64 ties-to-even at each final returned scalar, no intermediate float antipode

natha.exact_model: Exact cyclic difference of supplied binary64 right ascension and meridian; shortest arcA; day=60-A/3, night=A/3, Mercury=60.
natha.rounding: nearest IEEE binary64 ties-to-even at each final returned scalar, no intermediate float complement

reference: Fresh python-flint0.9.0/FLINT3.6.0 rational arithmetic, direct power-series sum (not production Horner), independent integer IEEE encoder. No FateBridge import or Fraction/fmpq float conversion for expected output.
gate: All original cases retained; every returned scalar hex equal; no numeric tolerance widening or alternate source picked for a passing score.
scope: Finite exact arithmetic of the declared mean/time models only. Not physical TDB/TT qualification, original-book unanimity, complete Shadbala, empirical prediction, exhaustive inventory or SOTA.
validation: Inputs/expected values frozen before production change. Validation producer does not execute product, and validation actual first read after a justified fix. Same-agent mathematical holdout, not statistical blindness.
duplicate_field_qualification: Seven fields per case reuse group values; overlapping checks are not seven independent algorithms or samples.
